headlines.summary: FDA granted accelerated approval to dostarlimab for adults with previously untreated Stage II/III dMMR or MSI-H locally advanced rectal cancer. Patients with a clinical complete response can enter intensive non-operative surveillance, creating an approved immunotherapy-first organ-preservation pathway while confirmatory clinical benefit remains required.
